svg.title: Eidetic Studio — MIDI & USB Routing
svg.text: Digital topology · Octatrack is the sole clock master · Ableton is NOT in the clock loop · PreSonus is the only audio-class USB device
Serial Thru-cascade. Each device re-sends clock + transport downstream.
Has a real MIDI THRU port
NO Thru port — use SOFT THRU: ON
End of chain — no Thru needed
One master = one timeline. No clock
free-runs OR slaves to OT over USB —
it never sends clock back to hardware.
buying any Thru box / Nome II.
Audio = PreSonus only, direct. Everything else = data/control via hub.
Overbridge + Transfer · audio via analogue outs, not USB
Driver / editor · audio via analogue outs, not USB
TRANSFER / STORAGE ONLY · no Overbridge · no MIDI/audio over USB
MIDI controller → Ableton · no audio function
14-in/12-out interface — UNPLUGGED for normal work. Multitrack experiments only.
• Serial Thru cascade, NOT a parallel splitter — each box re-transmits what it receives.
• TR-8S has no physical Thru jack; SOFT THRU passes clock onward (adds negligible latency).
• Keep DIN cables short (< 3 m) and screened to minimise jitter accumulating down the chain.
• If, and only if, you measure drift > ~5 ms over 5 min: evaluate a Kenton Thru box first,
then E-RM Multiclock / Nome II. Not before — the chain is genuinely short enough.
• Set each device’s clock/transport options once, then save (DT/OT projects, TR-8S kit/system).
1. PreSonus MUST be direct to the Mac — audio interfaces never go on the hub.
2. The hub carries data + control only (transfer, editors, MIDI controllers).
3. Octatrack MKII USB carries NO MIDI and NO audio — DIN + analogue outs exclusively.
4. No macOS Aggregate Device. PreSonus is the single audio device in Live’s prefs.
5. To run Soundcraft USB multitrack: just add it as a one-off experiment — unplug nothing,
accept it won’t be sample-locked to the PreSonus clock. Not a daily-workflow path.
6. DJM-850 USB soundcard: NEVER on the Mac — analogue REC OUT → PreSonus front In 1–2 only.
